title: Cracking the Crypto Code: Understanding the World of Cryptocurrency @crypto101podcast #crypto
transcript: the main question we really get asked is where do I put my bid to buy or sell and I would say find where price previously was before where are the previous lows that held up where the previous lows above it that acted as support that are now going to be resistance and just try and trade in a channel don't worry about huge breakouts or breakdowns when markets are sideways they're the most predictable and it's the easiest to trade
